hypotheses.R0_exact_recomposition: All-head state recomposition error remains at most 1e-3.
hypotheses.R1_pair_delta_beats_native_activity: True pair-delta ranking exceeds native base-activity ranking by at least 0.05 mean held-out energy fidelity.
hypotheses.R2_family_level_pairing_is_sufficient: A frozen cyclic permutation of sources within each discovery family retains top-three Jaccard at least 2/3 and held-out fidelity at least 0.80 in at least four families.
hypotheses.R3_arbitrary_matched_edits_do_not_explai: True pair-delta ranking exceeds the mean random replacement control by at least 0.10 fidelity, or fewer than three families have random-control mean fidelity at least 0.80 and percentile at least 0.80.
hypotheses.R4_suffix_magnitude_adds_distinct_rankin: State-norm and unlabeled-output top-three sets overlap by fewer than two heads on average across families.
hypotheses.R5_static_motif_enrichment_survives_two-: The smaller of the motif-membership and component-pair one-sided p-values remains at most 0.05 after a Bonferroni correction for the two reported tests.
